note: Free, limited-shelf-life items. Expiry dates are real; downloads come down when an item expires. No prices, no checkout, no counts.

items.name: The Know-Your-Agent Mandate Card
items.type: Free in-page mini tool plus mandate card, institution grid, prompts and team exercise (Markdown)
items.hook: Endowment effect (you write your own agent's mandate, so you own and keep its limits) plus loss aversion (a shared login hands an agent everything, with no mandate) and novelty bias (the 'know your agent' idea announced by MAS on 19 November 2026, with AXS opening 800+ Singapore billers to AI agents on 18 November); a snapshot of one week's news, so the tool and card come down after 29 November.

items.name: The Peak-Weekend Agent-Order Watch Card
items.type: Free watch card, prompts, huddle checklist and debrief template (Markdown)
items.hook: Pre-commitment (decide tripwires and owners before the weekend, not at 2 AM) plus urgency tied to a real window (Black Friday 27 November to Cyber Monday 30 November) and loss aversion (improvised decisions by whoever is on call); the card comes down after 28 November.
